correctness.rationale: For rooted PD Yk=sum_e 1{K meets distal clade}, inclusion-exclusion gives expectation and second moment in terms of clade sizes and pairwise-union sizes. Invertibility of the triangular matrix binom(n−s,k) (after terminal-size and k-boundary handling) makes equality of entire curves equivalent to equality of those histograms. Regrouping four equal-size subtrees preserves both histograms, and adding a new root tip preserves collisions for all n>16. Independently regenerated all rooted unordered binary shapes n<=16 (10,905 at 16), computed complete size/union signatures with bitmasks, found exactly one collision at n16 and none smaller, and independently enumerated all two-tip subsets of the displayed witnesses yielding third-moment gap −1/20. The finite census is exhaustive via canonical recursion, not sampled, and extension to infinity is analytic.
residual_risks: Only rooted unit-edge full binary nonplane trees and uniform without-replacement sampling; not unrooted PD or variable branch lengths.
